content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Cedar Rapids

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, associate degree, or high school diploma affects how many years of hands-on project experience you'll need to demonstrate. Gather your project documentation now.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP® Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend instructor-led sessions on your schedule from anywhere, covering the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios. Your completion certificate fulfills PMI's formal-education requirement for application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI, upload your project experience and education credentials, and pay the exam fee directly to PMI. The application process typically includes verification of your background; submit honestly and completely to avoid delays. Keep copies of all documentation for your records.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP® Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and Q&A support—to reinforce your understanding. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. On exam day, you'll answer 180 multiple-choice questions over three hours, testing your mastery of initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closing.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll hold an active PMP® credential. Over the standard three-year renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) by attending training, speaking, publishing, or serving your profession. Renew with PMI before expiration to keep your credential current and competitive in your career.
